# Grenada Administrative Divisions

> Open dataset of Grenada's administrative hierarchy:
> 8 parishs, 279 localitys.
> CC-BY-4.0 licensed.

## Quick Reference

- Total parishs: 8
- Total localitys: 279
- Coordinates: included (all levels)
- Last updated: 2026-08-20
- License: CC-BY-4.0

## Aggregate Data Files

- [All parishs (JSON)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/open-admin-data/grenada-administrative-divisions/main/data/all-parish.json)
- [All localitys (JSON)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/open-admin-data/grenada-administrative-divisions/main/data/all-locality.json)
- [Flat array (NDJSON)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/open-admin-data/grenada-administrative-divisions/main/data/all-flat.ndjson)
- [Hierarchy tree (JSON)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/open-admin-data/grenada-administrative-divisions/main/data/hierarchy.json)
- [JSON Schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/open-admin-data/grenada-administrative-divisions/main/data/schema.json)

## Schema Fields

- id: Unique identifier
- level: 1 (parish), 2 (locality)
- name: Local and English names with URL slug
- code: Government codes
- parent: Reference to parent division
- ancestors: Full chain to root
- children_count: Count of children per level
- zip_codes: Postal codes (where available)
- geo: Geographic coordinates (lat/lon, WGS84, all levels)
